name: Companhia Energética de Brasília - CEB
summary: Companhia Energética de Brasília - CEB, through its subsidiaries, generates and distributes electrical energy and gas in Brazil. The company operates through Power Generation, Commercialization of Electric Energy, Public Lighting, and Others segments. The company produces electrical energy from hydraulic power plants; distributes piped gas; public lighting services; and provides maintenance and expansion services.
